features.name: Score History Sidebar
features.description: Add an always-visible sidebar that displays complete game history chronologically with score and date for each game
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar is always visible on desktop during gameplay
All previous games are displayed in chronological order (newest first)
Each entry shows score and date
History persists in localStorage across sessions
Clear History button works with confirmation
Empty state displays when no games have been played
Sidebar is responsive (hidden on mobile screens <768px)
